title: Nano Nuclear Energy Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-08
summary: Nano Nuclear Energy Inc. submitted a private proposal to Dioxitek S.A., an Argentinian state-owned nuclear fuel company, for potential joint development of a natural uranium hexafluoride (UF6) production facility on Dioxitek's existing infrastructure in Argentina. This follows a Memorandum of Understanding executed in August 2025 and represents an early-stage, non-binding proposal that remains subject to review under Argentinian law and potential negotiation of definitive documentation.
key_points: Nano Nuclear Energy Inc. submitted a private proposal to Dioxitek S.A. (Argentina's state-owned nuclear fuel cycle company) for joint UF6 production facility development

The company is an emerging growth company as defined by SEC Rule 405
Common stock trades on Nasdaq under ticker NNE
